items.title: Hackers exploit WordPress plugin Post SMTP to hijack admin accounts
items.description: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in the Post SMTP plugin installed on more than 400,000 WordPress sites, to take complete control by hijacking administrator accounts. [...]

items.title: Pro-Russian Hackers Use Linux VMs to Hide in Windows
items.description: A threat actor known as "Curly COMrades" is using Linux VMs to remain undetected in Windows environments while conducting Russia-aligned activities.

items.title: Apache OpenOffice disputes data breach claims by ransomware gang
items.description: The Apache Software Foundation disputes claims that its OpenOffice project suffered an Akira ransomware attack, after the threat actors claimed to have stolen 23 GB of corporate documents. [...]

items.title: Europe Sees Increase in Ransomware, Extortion Attacks
items.description: European organizations face an escalating cyber threat landscape as attackers leverage geopolitical tensions and AI-enhanced social engineering for attacks.

items.title: New ‘SleepyDuck’ Malware in Open VSX Marketplace Allow Attackers to Control Windows Systems Remotely
items.description: A sophisticated remote access trojan named SleepyDuck has infiltrated the Open VSX IDE extension marketplace, targeting developers using code editors like Cursor and Windsurf. The malware disguised itself as a legitimate Solidity extension under the identifier juan-bianco.solidity-vlang, exploiting name squatting techniques to deceive unsuspecting users.
